source_window.dataset: OS OpenMap Local FunctionalSite technical specification

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building with explicit type/use evidence. The selected Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap Local FunctionalSite technical specification provides a MultiSurface geometry together with classification and distinctiveName semantics, but explicitly defines that geometry as the area or extent of a functional site rather than a physical building footprint, and the selected source window exposes no individual Exeter building record; therefore source-area/schema metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
